verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say you can "let Qodo apply the fix directly" from a PR finding [qodo-docs-3]. They also describe "Fix with Chat Agent" for remediating issues inside the PR chat [qodo-docs-51, qodo-docs-23], and findings include how to fix them [qodo-docs-2]. Agent-side resolution of findings is also offered through the Agentic Toolbox, MCP and plugins [qodo-docs-6, qodo-docs-29]. Missing for 10: detail on the fix mechanics (whether it commits a patch or opens a follow-up PR, and how changes are previewed or approved), and independent or hands-on corroboration that applying fixes in the PR works.
